completionCondition: JM-001 to JM-006 are merged into dev through one PR each with required checks green; on the final dev head CI passes EV-001 to EV-007 and EV-009 plus typecheck, lint, build, evals/harness.mjs, scripts/check-components.mjs and the Futari contract check; EV-008 passes locally under the thresholds in evals/cases/live-acceptance.json with its run log and owner audit committed under .futari/evidence/live/; and the owner records product acceptance in docs/futari/PROGRESS.md. Promotion to main and deployment are excluded.

requirements.description: Ask and stream: the owner submits a shopping question and sees ordered research progress until exactly one terminal state.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/chat streams data-progress parts in the order candidates, offers, validate, compare.
Each run ends in exactly one of completed, failed, or cancelled.
The UI shows the current stage, disables input while running, and offers Cancel.

requirements.description: Cited comparison: a completed run shows a comparison of 1-3 candidates whose citation markers resolve to Exa citations from the same run.
acceptanceCriteria: Every rendered source link is a citation URL returned by Exa in this run.
Out-of-range markers are removed and counted; paragraphs with no resolved marker are visibly flagged uncited.
All cases in evals/cases/citations.json produce their expected results.

requirements.description: Authentic, relevant merchant offers: only direct, validated merchant product pages for the candidate model are offers; other pages are labeled evidence or rejected; prices are never invented or edited.
acceptanceCriteria: Every displayed offer has merchant host, positive price, supported ISO currency, canonical http(s) URL from this run, availability enum value, source exa, and retrievedAt.
Aggregator, editorial, non-listing, price-less, and merchant-mismatch pages appear only in a separately labeled evidence section.
Irrelevant products, unsupported currencies, URLs not from the run, and non-http URLs never appear as offers.
All 54 cases in evals/cases/offer-classification.json produce their labeled outcome, category, and offer fields.

requirements.description: Currency-safe ranking: offers group by USD, SGD, JPY with the selected market's currency first, sort deterministically within a group, and are never compared across currencies.
acceptanceCriteria: All cases in evals/cases/ranking-currency.json produce the expected groups and order.
A seeded property test over 1,000 generated offer lists shows no mixed-currency group and no lost or duplicated offers beyond the canonical-URL collapse.

requirements.description: Failure recovery: Exa errors and cancellation end the run with a typed, visible reason, partial results are labeled, and live mode never falls back to fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: 401, 402 or credit errors, 429, 5xx, timeout, no candidates, and no offers each yield the specified data-error kind or empty state; a client cancel aborts the Exa call, ends the stream, and shows the client-side cancelled state.
A failure after the candidates stage sets partial true and keeps already validated products visible.
The next question works after any failure.

requirements.description: Spend guard and cache: at most 5 Exa requests per question by construction, at most 3 for a normal question, 6-hour cache, monthly limits, and stop on exhausted credits.
acceptanceCriteria: No sequence of candidates, retries, or errors makes a sixth Exa call in one run.
A repeated question within the TTL makes no Exa call and shows the original retrievedAt.
Monthly request and cost limits block calls before they are made; a 402 or credit error blocks later calls until reset.
Each response's costDollars.total is added to the ledger and shown in the run's usage.

requirements.description: Local and key safety: the server listens only on 127.0.0.1, rejects foreign Host or Origin, and the Exa key never leaves the server process.
acceptanceCriteria: The listen address is hard-coded to 127.0.0.1; requests with a foreign Host or cross-origin Origin get 403.
A test key string is absent from a production build, server logs, .cache/, evals/fixtures/, API responses, and browser storage.

requirements.description: Live acceptance: the 6-query live suite across US, SG, and JP meets the agreed thresholds within the live usage limits before the MVP is declared complete.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 4 of 6 queries show at least one merchant offer.
100% of displayed offers pass revalidation against the recorded Exa responses, and at least 90% pass the owner's audit rubric.
Zero fabricated offers and no unexpected error runs; at most 5 requests per query and $0.40 reported cost per suite run.

requirements.description: Persistent local history: the conversation survives reloads through versioned, validated localStorage and can be cleared with confirmation; no secret is stored in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: After a reload the full conversation, including results, is restored.
Clear history asks for confirmation, then empties the thread and removes kensaku.history.v1.
Invalid stored data is discarded with a visible notice.

requirements.description: Frontend quality and components: the UI uses unmodified official AI Elements and shadcn/ui components, has a persistent market selector, and meets accessibility, layout, and owner visual review.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/check-components.mjs confirms every installed component file matches components.lock.json and components.json lists the @ai-elements registry.
axe reports zero serious or critical violations on empty, running, completed, and error states; the journey works by keyboard alone.
At 375 px width there is no horizontal page scroll.
The owner records visual review in .futari/evidence/JM-005.md.

evaluations.description: Merchant authenticity: classify all frozen cases (40 live Exa results, 14 synthetic) as merchant offer, labeled evidence, or rejected.
evaluations.passRule: 54/54 cases in evals/cases/offer-classification.json match the labeled outcome and category, and for offers the labeled currency, amount, canonicalUrl and availability where given; the test asserts the evaluated case count equals the file's case count.

evaluations.description: Product relevance: identity matching rejects wrong and near-miss products and accepts every labeled right product.
evaluations.passRule: 100% of cases in evals/cases/offer-classification.json are classified irrelevant-product exactly when labeled so.

evaluations.description: Currency grouping, market ordering, and deterministic ranking.
evaluations.passRule: All 4 cases in evals/cases/ranking-currency.json match exactly, and the seeded 1,000-list property test finds no mixed-currency group and no lost or duplicated offers.

evaluations.description: Citation resolution and URL provenance for comparisons and offers.
evaluations.passRule: All 6 cases in evals/cases/citations.json match; in fixture pipeline runs every rendered source URL is in the run's citations and every offer URL is in the run's search results.

evaluations.description: Spend guard at two levels: unit (RequestBudget, cache, ledger limits, exhausted-credit stop; JM-003) and run (pipeline call counts, cached repeats, single-run lock; JM-004).
evaluations.passRule: Unit: a sixth token is refused, cache hits use no token and keep retrievedAt, limits block before calling, and a 402 or credit error blocks later calls. Run: every scripted scenario stays within 5 calls, a normal question uses at most 3, a cached repeat uses 0 with the original retrievedAt, and a concurrent second run gets 409.

evaluations.description: UI message stream shape and failure states through the Hono app with scripted Exa behaviour.
evaluations.passRule: For success, no candidates, no offers, 401, 402, 429, 500, and timeout scenarios, the stream has ordered progress parts, exactly one terminal state, the expected data-error kind and partial flag, and no fixture data in live mode; for a client abort, the Exa call is aborted, no parts follow, and a cancelled log line is written; after every scenario the run lock is released and the next request succeeds.

evaluations.description: Frontend quality: Playwright journey, states, history, market, accessibility, layout, absence of the key from browser storage, and component integrity, plus owner visual review.
evaluations.passRule: All Playwright checks listed in docs/futari/EVALUATION_PLAN.md section Frontend quality pass, scripts/check-components.mjs exits 0, and the owner's visual review is recorded as accepted.

evaluations.description: Live acceptance of 6 queries across US, SG, and JP against the real Exa API with owner audit.
evaluations.passRule: Thresholds in evals/cases/live-acceptance.json: at least 4/6 queries with a merchant offer, 100% revalidation, at least 90% owner audit pass, zero fabricated offers, no unexpected errors, at most 30 requests and $0.40 reported cost per suite run, at most 3 suite runs.

evaluations.description: Loopback binding, Host and Origin guards, and absence of the key from every artifact.
evaluations.passRule: The running server listens on 127.0.0.1, foreign Host and Origin get 403, and a test key string is absent from a production build the test makes itself, from server logs of a fixture run, .cache/, evals/fixtures/, and API responses.

tasks.title: Scaffold toolchain, install official components, and add deterministic CI
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test, and pnpm build succeed.
All runtime and dev dependencies named in docs/futari/ARCHITECTURE.md are installed with exact versions.

components.json lists the @ai-elements registry and aliases hooks to src/web/lib/hooks; .mcp.json pins shadcn@4.23.0; the shadcn CLI installed AI Elements conversation, message, prompt-input, suggestion, task, inline-citation, sources, shimmer and shadcn table, badge, select, alert-dialog, alert; components.lock.json records their SHA-256 hashes; scripts/check-components.mjs passes.
pnpm start serves the web shell and GET /api/health on 127.0.0.1:8787 only.

.github/workflows/ci.yml, named CI, runs install, typecheck, lint, test, build, test:e2e, evals/harness.mjs, and check-components on pull requests to dev and on pushes to dev, without secrets; pnpm test:e2e passes with a Playwright smoke spec in tests/e2e/ that loads the shell.
.gitignore also ignores .cache/, test-results/, and playwright-report/.

tasks.title: Implement pure offer, identity, currency, ranking, and citation rules
acceptanceCriteria: src/core follows the file layout and exports the types and functions specified in docs/futari/ARCHITECTURE.md, with no I/O and no exa-js import.
EV-001, EV-002, EV-003, and EV-004 pass, loading the frozen case files unchanged.
The citation fixture-run part of EV-004 is covered by JM-004; this task covers the six citation cases.

tasks.title: Implement Exa port, request budget, cache, usage ledger, and error mapping
acceptanceCriteria: src/exa/ follows the file layout in docs/futari/ARCHITECTURE.md (port.ts ExaPort, budget.ts RequestBudget, errors.ts ExaFailure, sdk-port.ts, fixture-port.ts, cache.ts, ledger.ts) with the signatures given there; ExaSdkPort is the only module importing exa-js; FixtureExaPort replays named scenarios from tests/fixtures/scenarios/, including baseline scenarios xm5-us, xm5-sg, and xm5-jp, with synthetic responses labeled synthetic.
RequestBudget makes a sixth call impossible by construction; the cache, ledger, and error mapping behave as specified in docs/futari/ARCHITECTURE.md.
The unit-level part of EV-005 passes with no network access; the run-level part is covered by JM-004.

tasks.title: Vertical slice: pipeline, streaming API, and minimal AI Elements chat UI with live smoke
acceptanceCriteria: runResearch executes the fixed stages with at most 5 Exa calls and yields typed RunEvents; POST /api/chat converts them to the UI message stream parts in docs/futari/ARCHITECTURE.md.
The server binds 127.0.0.1 only and enforces the Host and Origin guards; fixture mode requires NODE_ENV=test and shows a banner.
The UI, composed only from installed AI Elements and shadcn components, renders progress, cited comparison, offer table, and separate evidence for a fixture run in a Playwright test.
EV-004 (including fixture pipeline runs), the run-level part of EV-005, EV-006, and EV-009 pass, and EV-001 to EV-003 still pass after any src/core fix.

A live smoke of Q1 and Q2 makes at most 10 Exa requests in total; Q1 shows at least one merchant offer that passes revalidation; the Q2 outcome and whether /answer accepted userLocation are recorded; both logs are committed under .futari/evidence/live/ at or before the Tested-Commit.

tasks.title: Complete the frontend: market selector, persistent history, all states, accessibility
acceptanceCriteria: Market selector (US, SG, JP) persists and changes request market and group order.
History persists across reloads, clears with confirmation, and recovers from invalid stored data with a notice.
Every UI state in docs/futari/PRODUCT_SPEC.md is implemented.
Files under src/web/components/ change only through the shadcn CLI, with components.lock.json updated in the same commit.
EV-007 automated checks pass and the owner's visual review is recorded in .futari/evidence/JM-005.md.

tasks.title: Live acceptance suite, owner audit, and final integration on dev
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm live:acceptance runs Q1-Q6 with a fresh cache within the live budget and writes a run log with every request, displayed offer, and reported cost under .futari/evidence/live/; every run log is committed at or before the Tested-Commit.
EV-008 thresholds are met under the runRules in evals/cases/live-acceptance.json, including the owner's audit of every displayed offer.
All deterministic suites, including EV-001 to EV-004 on the frozen cases, still pass after any fix made here.
README.md explains setup, EXA_ENV_FILE, pnpm start, limits, and data caveats.
